notes.title: New Custom Trail Colors added to Kick Bot!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BAXG_PBeG6A;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Why allow players to choose a trail color?[/h3]

One of our most requested features from folks who streamed the demo is a way to customize the character cosmetically.

Now streamers (or anyone) can make Kick Bot a little more their own!

More trail color combos to come but I started with adding all of the pride flags to show support for our friends in the LGBTQ+ community and because it was a fun challenge to implement all of the gradients! We currently have 19 trails color combos and hope to add more soon.


[b]Wishlists today, it really helps us out a lot![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136290?utm_source=streamcommunity
More about Kick Bot:

[b]
Kick Bot is a TWO BUTTON platformer where you can’t walk – only wall-jump![/b]

    - Two Button game (yes only two!)

    - Kick Bot can't walk, 100% wall jumping!

    ⁠- Giant robot leg on the Moon wants to kick the Earth

    - All levels take place inside the GIGALeg, 7 unique leg themed worlds like 'Thunder Thigh' and 'Inflamed Knee'

    - Over 140 levels in the full game

    - GBA-inspired style

    - Love letter to 16bit games like Mega Man X, DKC, Sonic, Yoshi's Island, Metroid and more!

Thanks so much for watching our video, feel free to leave any feedback, and have a great day!

We would love to have you try the demo today and give us your feedback!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136290?utm_source=streamcommunity

notes.title: Kick Bot - Dev Update - New Camera Sneak Peek Video
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CytNXfkiuD8;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been hard at work revamping the camera in Kick Bot and fine-tuning each level. The new camera (coming soon) will show you more of what is coming up and give you a better view of the entire room you are in. This has been no easy task but is one of the most comprehensive upgrades we have worked on for the game.

Wishlist Kick Bot on Steam for updates: http://wishlist.kickbotgame.com

Stay tuned for a new demo to drop on the Kick Bot steam page when we are done with the camera update, and if you are part of our beta a new beta build will be coming soon as well.

Speaking of the Kick Bot beta, if you are interested in trying out 70+ full levels of Kick Bot head over to our Discord and sign up today! 

[url=http://discord.gg/twoscoopgames][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35643713/cc50d9642fb294d652882ef4f5788cc6fe892071.png[/img][/url]
